overall.verdict: A visually disciplined, premium-feeling dark wallet with genuinely differentiated honesty (provable payments, evidence bundles, one absolute bar scale), held back by jargon leakage, duplicate or half-finished controls, and several near-empty screens. Legibility of the core risk model — green yours vs violet promised — is close but not yet self-explanatory.
priority_fixes: Unify the bar-scale system: match segment colors to legend on every screen, label segment values in text, and handle sub-pixel amounts explicitly
Fix broken/overlapping layouts: 15-sovereignty header overflow, 16-desk order-book clipping, 17-palette missing scrim, and the large dead space on 01/11/14
Replace or finish the Swap collateral-credit dead end (05-swap): one primary unblocking action, remove 'not available yet' copy
De-jargonize: rename 'entity id', 'Frame #', 'Prepare incoming account', 'Lazy board', 'Depository may pull', with plain-language subtitles and glosses
Differentiate activity detail (08): real per-payment drill-down with route timeline, per-hop deltas, and copy/verify proof actions
